nodes.label: Stack recommendation: self-hosted GraphHopper, Supabase PostGIS, SwiftUI MapKit, on-device Apple AI, RevenueCat
nodes.rationale: GraphHopper is the only engine with a native round-trip primitive plus custom cost models over proprietary data. Infra $75 to $95/month at MVP.

nodes.label: Stack choice: self-hosted GraphHopper routing (moat data cannot run hosted)
nodes.rationale: Hosted APIs cannot ingest proprietary crossing/lighting data; a hosted primary reduces Waypoint to commodity routing.

nodes.label: Stack choice: on-device Apple Foundation Models for coaching
nodes.rationale: Health data never leaves the device, collapsing the GDPR Article 9 server surface.
